Reads entry count this[0x8] and the entry-array base this[0xC]; iterates with a 24-byte stride, comparing each entry name (falling back to byte_5EA438 when the name pointer is null) via sub_588410. Returns this[0xC] + 24*v3 for the matching entry, or 0 when the table is empty or exhausted (optionally logging a tire-brand-not-found error through StringSplitLoop/DebugLogWrite).

Match guard: if sub_588410 reports equality, return the entry address this[0xC] + 24*v3.
Advance to the next entry: v3 += 1 and v4 += 24.
